title: Finite additivity of the probability measure
statement:
Let $\Omega$ be a finite probability space and let $\iota$ be a finite index set. If $(A_i)_{i \in \iota}$ is a pairwise disjoint family of subsets of $\Omega$, then the probability of their union is the sum of their probabilities:
\[
  \mathbb{P}\!\Bigl(\bigcup_{i \in \iota} A_i\Bigr) \;=\; \sum_{i \in \iota} \mathbb{P}(A_i),
\]
where $\mathbb{P}(\,\cdot\,) \in \bbr$ denotes the real-valued probability measure of $\Omega$.
hypotheses_covered: Ω is a finite probability space
ι is a finite index type
